## TL;DR

- [Future of programming, AI and agentic engineering][1] with DHH and Lex Fridman

## Future of programming, AI and agentic engineering

In his second conversation with [Lex Fridman][2], [DHH][3] talks about programming with agents, vibe coding versus agentic engineering and how he builds [Omarchy][4] these days. I'm glued to the episode whenever he talks: the way he speaks and his attitude make it great to listen to, and it got me really excited to embrace AI.

My takeaway: try AI engineering, seriously. The episode made me try and adopt [Skills for Real Engineers][5] by [Matt Pocock][6]. They deserve their own TIL, so stay tuned.
